facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that the Data Protection Act (2019), the Constitution and the Kenya Cloud Policy (2025) govern cross-border transfer of personal data in Kenya, and that the ODPC guidance sets out the legal obligations and conditions for lawful transfer abroad; the article gives no date for the rule itself, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Kenya cross-border transfer framework (Data Protection Act 2019 and ODPC guidance)

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports the ODPC, through data commissioner Immaculate Kassait, has issued guidance on cross-border data transfers covering the conditions for lawful transfer, the safeguards required and the mechanisms for adequate protection; the article dates the report, not the issue, so the published date is used.
facts.system: ODPC guidance on cross-border data transfers
